profile.headline: Senior Backend Software Engineer  | Python | Javascript | C | AWS | SQL
profile.summary:
Seasoned software developer with a strong foundation in Electrical and Computer Engineering and 10 years of professional experience, offering a proven record of success in designing and implementing robust, fault-tolerant, high-performance solutions for embedded systems, backend services, and infrastructure. Known for strong communication and organizational skills, adaptability, quality code, and collaboration to drive key business objectives.

Excited to leverage my previous experience to work on exciting new technologies in the aerospace, defense, financial services, medtech, automotive, logistics, or energy industry. Highly motivated to expand my knowledge and experience with data engineering and cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Supporting fullstack development, test, and integration efforts for the user-facing visualization component of a Space Force sensor data processing application, as part of the FORGE program.

positions.title: Lead Software Architect
positions.description:
Co-founder of a consultancy specializing in technology and software services.

Contributed to proposals for new business, and helped secure a contract with a hedge fund for the development and maintenance of a data collection service.

Spun off a non-profit organization aimed at providing a public notification service for water quality alerts in Jackson, MS.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Project Management · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Python (Programming Language) · Microsoft Excel · Proposal Writing · Client Relations · Selenium WebDriver · Pandas (Software) · SQL

positions.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed backend RESTful web API's for Product Infrastructure on Qualcomm's Test Base Station (TBS), a proprietary wireless test platform used by hundreds of test engineers daily to flexibly configure, test, and analyze leading edge 4G/5G software and hardware. The development of TBS as an alternative to third-party platforms results in millions of dollars of cost reduction for the company annually.

Collaborated and interfaced with multiple stakeholders across the organization, ranging from the web front-end to a variety of server software modules running concurrently in a distributed ecosystem of servers and test hardware.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key member of Modem Common Services team working on Qualcomm's best-in-class 4G/5G system-on-chip Snapdragon modems through 4 major product life cycles. Supported feature development (requirements, commercialization, support) from product release through maturity for many customers in multiple markets (North America, China, India).

Developed C/C++ libraries and services for arbitrating between various radio access technologies (5G/LTE/W-CDMA/TDS-CDMA) to schedule and efficiently allocate transceiver resources in a complex concurrency environment with strict time, memory, and power constraints. Supporting all these wireless protocols seamlessly is extremely important to Qualcomm’s mission.

Worked on critical modem features such as multi-sim, MIMO, antenna path diversity, and specific absorption rate (SAR) power limiting algorithms.

positions.title: Modem Software Intern
positions.description: Worked in the Modem Common Services team in Qualcomm CMDA Technologies (QCT) group. Implemented a Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) algorithm which intelligently optimized transmit power-limiting to increase LTE uplink throughput in poor channel conditions, while remaining FCC compliant. SAR measures the radiation to which human tissue is exposed when using personal wireless devices.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Algorithm Design · Communication · Wireless Communications Systems · Test-Driven Development

positions.title: MSP RF Antenna Group Intern
positions.description: Drove a new anechoic test chamber error characterization initiative in the MSP Antennas Group for high-powered defense satellite antennas. Organized large amounts of experimental data graphically and analyzed radiation patterns using MATLAB.
positions.insights: Skills: Matlab · Presentation Skills · Data Analysis · Antenna Measurements · Scripting · Information Graphics

positions.title: Systems VLSI Lab Intern
positions.description: Developed scripts to benchmark performance of the newest traffic routing ASICs in HP Enterprise (Griffinhawk and Dragonhawk) Server blades. Implemented throttling code in simulated PCI Express blocks to prevent buildup of injected packets.
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Perl · Test Automation · Algorithms

positions.title: Summer Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
NSF EURECA Research Experience for Undergraduates at UT Austin Wireless Networking and Communications Group (WNCG), PHAROS mobile testbed laboratory.

Investigated Autonomous Intersection Management (AIM) algorithms and developed proof-of-concept experiments with mobile networked robots. AIM guides vehicles through intersections without human interaction, while attempting to maximize throughput and reduce collisions. 

Implemented an algorithm developed by the UT-CS department, motor control drivers for camera positioning, and designed and executed lab trials for lane following using real-time camera feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Sensors · Robotics · Robot Operating System (ROS) · Wireless Sensor Networks · Research Skills

projects.title: PerfDiff: Analyzing Performance Differences between Multiple Code Revisions
projects.description: PerfDiff is a tool to analyze the performance differences between two revisions and identify the program edits responsible for such difference, especially performance regression.

organizations.name: Mile High Young Professionals
organizations.description: Professional and networking organization for young professionals in Denver. Participated in community service events, professional meetups, networking events, and hope to hold a committee/board position in the future.

organizations.position: Corresponding Secretary, Cataloguer, Student Engineering Council Representative · Jun 2011 - Present
organizations.description: Became a member in sophomore year, went on to hold multiple leadership positions in the organization and participated in various community service, professional, and social events throughout my tenure at the University of Texas.
